goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann Umwelt- und Lebensqualitätsindikatoren interpretieren.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native 16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Existing format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Environmental air/water/ecosystem symbols and human quality-of-life social/health/education symbols are contrasted over a shared settlement. No values, causal coefficients or universal indicator ranking are invented; the common setting invites interpretation of different dimensions.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px both panel headings and all large indicator-family icons remain recognizable. Building slogans and background micro-scenes are optional.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the shared surroundings, public transport, social life and educational context provide clear concrete examples without cluttering the central panels.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The presenter gestures toward both panels for an audience; the open book is a non-directional icon and public signs face the scene rather than an actor reading a reversed page.
actualInspection.style: Friendly approachable comic raster, clear broad colors, large conceptual objects; no photorealistic or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The icon panels are selected indicator families, not an exhaustive index or a claim that environment and human welfare never overlap.
goalTextStatus: Current German competence unchanged in the E2 bilingual candidate; this image review does not attest the positive-evidence profile or bilingual description gate.
